rootCause: Left-column item 0 is 322.8pt wide (right edge 394.8), so it crosses mid (306). The old classifier required itemRight < mid-14 to count as left, leaving only 'the lock point.' on the left (1 line) and failing TWO_COL_MIN_LINES=3. Same-Y grouping then put left and right first-lines on one visual line. shouldInsertSpace saw a negative gap (-54.8) and concatenated before+Snapshot. Wrap leftover 'extra ch the lock point' is that mash plus the next visual line. PDF.js also clipped the overflowing right-column string to 'extra ch'.
